message.content:
**Allele frequency of rs7412 in Europeans**

| Allele | Frequency (European populations) |
|--------|----------------------------------|
| **C** (major allele) | ≈ 0.93 (93 %) |
| **T** (minor allele) | ≈ 0.07 (7 %) |

*Source:* gnomAD v2.1.1 (Exome Aggregation Consortium) – “Population allele frequencies” for the European (non-Finnish) subset.  
*Note:* The minor‑allele frequency (MAF) of rs7412 (T allele) is about 7 % in the overall European cohort, but it varies slightly among sub‑populations (e.g., ~5 % in Finnish Europeans, ~9 % in non‑Finnish Europeans).  

This SNP is one of the two defining variants of the APOE gene (the other being rs429358). The combination of rs7412 and rs429358 alleles determines the ε2/ε3/ε4 APOE haplotypes.
